wages.text: In a Labor Day statement, Waters said she is fighting to raise the federal minimum wage and protect workers' right to organize.
wages.quote: Democrats are fighting to protect the right to organize and increase the federal minimum wage.

housing.text: Waters championed legislation to build and preserve more affordable homes and direct cities to open unused land to developers.
housing.quote: H.R. 6644 sets the stage for building and preserving more affordable homes in our neighborhoods.

immigration.text: Waters supports letting undocumented immigrants gain legal status and opposes mass deportation.
immigration.quote: We simply cannot arrest, detain, jail and/or deport 11 million undocumented immigrants.

health.text: Waters cast the deciding vote to pass the House health care reform bill expanding coverage to millions.
health.quote: it will extend coverage to 36 million more Americans who currently lack health insurance

voting.text: Waters voted to reauthorize the Voting Rights Act and champions protecting access to the ballot.
voting.quote: Today, I cast a vote on behalf of the millions of men and women across the nation who have been blocked, intimidated, beaten, and even killed trying to exercise their Constitutionally guaranteed right to vote

tax.text: Morales proposes reducing California’s gas, sales, and income tax burdens to at least the median among states.
tax.quote: Reducing our tax burden to at least the middle when compared to other states would enable California to remain competitive.

trade.text: Morales supports federal tariffs on foreign-built manufacturing to encourage domestic job growth.
trade.quote: Supports federal tariffs on foreign-built manufacturing to incentivize domestic job growth.

debt.text: In a candidate survey he said the country spends too much and that the government should cut spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: As a country we spend too much which is why we are 39 Trillion in debt.

schools.text: He said the U.S. Department of Education should be eliminated and control returned to states, including school choice for parents.
schools.quote: This change is needed to give back more control to each state to tailor its educational offerings i.e. school choice to each parent.

safety.text: Morales supports stricter penalties for violent crime and criticizes prosecutors who reduce crime penalties.
safety.quote: I, however, won’t tolerate violent crime. It is a disturbing trend that recent district attorneys specifically in San Francisco and Los Angeles, have decided to reduce crime penalties.

guns.text: He said he supports the individual right to bear arms and that gun restrictions tend to make the public less safe.
guns.quote: I support the unalienable rights for individuals to bear arms.

abortion.text: He said human life deserves legal protection from conception until natural death.
abortion.quote: Human life does deserve legal protection from conception until natural death.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He said biological males should not participate in women's sports or use women's spaces such as bathrooms, locker rooms, shelters, and prisons.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: He said existing Medicaid and Medicare should remain but no other taxpayer-funded health programs are necessary, opposing expansion of public coverage.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary.

energy.text: Morales supports low-cost solar and opposes punitive measures affecting oil-industry workers while they retrain for net-zero goals.
energy.quote: I believe focusing on the simple, achievable tasks first would allow more individuals to adopt personal responsibility towards the environment rather than a punitive approach that appears dystopian to Californians whose jobs are dependent on the oil industry.

voting.text: In a candidate survey he strongly disagreed with the statement that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification.
